mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing ibuprofen metabolism and systemic exposure, while concurrent use increases GI and renal toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for signs of ibuprofen toxicity (GI bleeding, renal dysfunction) and consider alternative antifungal if prolonged ibuprofen use is necessary; use lowest effective ibuprofen dose.
